sv.title: Portugisisk storägare säljer i Scandi Standard – aktien sjunker
sv.summary: Kycklingproducenten Scandi Standards storägare, portugisiska Grupo Lusiaves, har sålt cirka 28.000 aktier i bolaget för drygt 5,6 miljoner kronor, framgår av Finansinspektionens insynsregister.

en.title: Portuguese major shareholder sells in Scandi Standard – share falls
en.summary: Poultry producer Scandi Standard's major shareholder, Portugal's Grupo Lusiaves, has sold around 28,000 shares in the company for just over SEK 5.6 million, according to the Financial Supervisory Authority's insider register.
